arxiv-2105-05577.title: Two-color coherent control in photoemission from gold needle tips
arxiv-2105-05577.creator: Philip Dienstbier, Timo Paschen, Peter Hommelhoff
arxiv-2105-05577.description: Abstract We demonstrate coherent control of photoemission from a gold needle tip using a two-color laser field. The relative phase between a fundamental field and its second harmonic imprints a strong modulation on the emitted photocurrent with up to 96.5 % contrast. The contrast as a function of the second harmonic intensity can be described by three interfering quantum pathways.

arxiv-2302-05781.title: Transport Signatures of Fractional Quantum Hall Binding Transitions
arxiv-2302-05781.creator: Christian Spånslätt, Ady Stern, Alexander D. Mirlin
arxiv-2302-05781.description: Abstract Certain fractional quantum Hall edges have been predicted to undergo quantum phase transitions which reduce the number of edge channels and at the same time bind electrons together. However, detailed studies of experimental signatures of such a “binding transition” remain lacking.

arxiv-2404-08376.title: Graph data augmentation with Gromow-Wasserstein Barycenters
arxiv-2404-08376.creator: Andrea Ponti
arxiv-2404-08376.description: Abstract Graphs are ubiquitous in various fields, and deep learning methods have been successful applied in graph classification tasks. However, building large and diverse graph datasets for training can be expensive. While augmentation techniques exist for structured data like images or numerical data, the augmentation of graph data remains challenging.

arxiv-2410-14091.title: Towards Effective Planning Strategies for Dynamic Opinion Networks
arxiv-2410-14091.creator: Bharath Muppasani, Protik Nag, Vignesh Narayanan, Biplav Srivastava, Michael N. Huhns
arxiv-2410-14091.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate the under-explored intervention planning aimed at disseminating accurate information within dynamic opinion networks by leveraging learning strategies. Intervention planning involves identifying key nodes (search) and exerting control (e.g., disseminating accurate/official information through the nodes) to mitigate the influence of misinformation. However, as the network size increases, the problem becomes computationally intractable.

arxiv-2412-02968.title: How Many Ratings per Item are Necessary for Reliable Significance Testing?
arxiv-2412-02968.creator: Christopher M. Homan, Flip Korn, Deepak Pandita, Chris Welty
arxiv-2412-02968.description: Abstract A cornerstone of machine learning evaluation is the (often hidden) assumption that model and human responses are reliable enough to evaluate models against unitary, authoritative, “gold standard” data, via simple metrics such as accuracy, precision, and recall. The generative AI revolution would seem to explode this assumption, given the critical role stochastic inference plays.

arxiv-2509-04970.title: DeGuV : Depth-Guided Visual Reinforcement Learning for Generalization and Interpretability in Manipulation
arxiv-2509-04970.creator: Tien Pham, Xinyun Chi, Khang Nguyen, Manfred Huber, Angelo Cangelosi
arxiv-2509-04970.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) agents can learn to solve complex tasks from visual inputs, but generalizing these learned skills to new environments remains a major challenge in RL application, especially robotics. While data augmentation can improve generalization, it often compromises sample efficiency and training stability. This paper introduces DeGuV , an RL framework that enhances both generalization and sample efficiency.

pmc-10582489.title: Real-world use and perceptions of shared decision-making for allergy and asthma care in a US population
pmc-10582489.creator: Jacqueline Eghrari-Sabet, Dennis Williams, Don A Bukstein, Tonya Winders, Donna D Gardner
pmc-10582489.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundShared decision-making (SDM), the process of engaging patients in their healthcare decisions, is an integral component of personalized medicine. The use of SDM in real-world allergy and asthma care in the United States (US) is unknown.

pmc-11483772.title: Covalently Linked 2D-Co3O4/GO Heterostructures: Catalytic and Electrochemical Properties
pmc-11483772.creator: Jéssica
pmc-11483772.description: Covalently cross-linked 2D heterostructures may represent a ground-breaking approach to creating materials with multifunctionalities. To date, however, this field still remains relatively unexplored. In the present work, Co3O4/GO covalently linked heterostructures (Co3O4/GO-CL) were produced using 2D-Co3O4 functionalized with (3-aminopropyl)triethoxysilane (APTES) to react with the carboxyl groups of graphene oxide (GO).

pmc-11531910.title: Efficacy of Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation (TENS) for Management of Pain Associated With Hysteroscopy: A Systematic Review
pmc-11531910.creator: Juliet Galtes, Rachel Siretskiy, Lauren Offield, Benny Esquenazi
pmc-11531910.description: Transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) therapy is a simple, non-pharmacologic, and non-invasive analgesic intervention that involves the application of electric currents over an area of pain to stimulate underlying nerves. The methodology behind TENS is based on theories of pain perception and processing such as the gate control theory, descending inhibition, and release of endogenous opioids.

pmc-12597856.title: AI-assisted differentiation of nontuberculous mycobacterial pulmonary disease from colonization: a multi-center study
pmc-12597856.creator: Chia-Jung Liu, Yueh-Chun Liu, Yu-Hsuan Chen, Yu-Sen Huang, Po-Chih Kuo, Meng-Rui Lee, Lu-Cheng Kuo, Jann-Yuan Wang, Chao-Chi Ho, Jin-Yuan Shih, Chong-Jen Yu
pmc-12597856.description: ObjectivesDifferentiating between nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) pulmonary disease (NTM-PD) and colonization (NTM-PC) is clinically important but difficult. It remains unknown whether artificial intelligence utilizing clinical data and chest CT images could address this clinical problem.Materials and methodsPatients were retrospectively recruited with NTM isolation from respiratory specimens in two hospitals. Their disease or colonization status was determined by three NTM experts.

pmc-12607557.title: Behavioral Balance in Tryptophan Turmoil: Regional Metabolic Rewiring in Kynurenine Aminotransferase II Knockout Mice
pmc-12607557.creator: Ágnes Szabó, Zsolt Galla, Eleonóra Spekker, Diána Martos, Mónika Szűcs, Annamária Fejes-Szabó, Ágnes Fehér, Keiko Takeda, Kinuyo Ozaki, Hiromi Inoue, Sayo Yamamoto, Péter Monostori, József Toldi, Etsuro Ono, László Vécsei, Masaru Tanaka, Korrapati V Sathyasaikumar, Sarah Beggiato, Verónica Pérez de
pmc-12607557.description: Background: Cognitive, emotional, and social impairments are pervasive across neuropsychiatric conditions, where alterations in the tryptophan (Trp)–kynurenine pathway and its product kynurenic acid (KYNA) from kynurenine aminotransferases (KATs) have been linked to Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, depression, and post-traumatic stress disorder.

pmc-12644628.title: Value-based large language model agent simulation for mutual evaluation of trust and interpersonal closeness
pmc-12644628.creator: Yuki Sakamoto, Takahisa Uchida, Hiroshi Ishiguro
pmc-12644628.description: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for simulating complex social phenomena using human-like agents with specific traits. In human societies, value similarity is important for building trust and close relationships; however, it remains unexplored whether this principle holds true in artificial societies comprising LLM agents.

pmc-13459513.title: Transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) with or without immune checkpoint inhibitors in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma: a meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials☆
pmc-13459513.creator: H Kim, TC Felismino, A Lício Júnior, GR Almeida, ABC Brito
pmc-13459513.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundTransarterial chemoembolization (TACE) is the standard of care for intermediate-stage unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but progression-free survival (PFS) with TACE alone remains limited. Recent randomized clinical trials have evaluated the addition of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) to TACE.

uslaw-usc-t42-s16392.title: 42 U.S.C. § 16392 — Technology Infrastructure Program
uslaw-usc-t42-s16392.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s16392.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 149 (National Energy Policy And Programs); Subchapter X (Department Of Energy Management). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Program The term “Program” means the Technology Infrastructure Program established under subsection (b). (2) Technology cluster The term “technology cluster” means a concentration of technology-related business concerns, institutions.
